Superseded function names

Source: R/superseded.R
superseded.Rd

In 0.4.3 every exported function took the sframe_ prefix or a stage verb, so a name says which stage it belongs to and no 2 names sit 1 letter apart. The old names still work and give the same result, with no warning. Set options(surveyframe.warn_superseded = TRUE) to get 1 warning per old name per session, naming its replacement.

Arguments

...

Passed to the new function.

instrument, scales, std_lv

Passed to sframe_syntax_cfa(). instrument is also passed to launch_studio() by launch_dashboard().

open

Passed to launch_builder() or preview_survey().

screen, port, host, launch.browser

Passed to launch_studio().

name, where

Passed to preview_survey(), as its x and where.

x

An instrument.

value

The analysis plan, as for sframe_plan().

responses

A data frame of responses, passed to launch_studio().

Value

What the new function returns.

Examples

# The old name and the new one make the same item
identical(sf_item("q1", "Question 1", type = "text"),
          sframe_item("q1", "Question 1", type = "text"))
#> [1] TRUE
